title.description: One-line issue title. Plain statement of the defect, or the honest shape of the work ("Figure out how to retire X"). No trailing period.

draft_path.description: Absolute path of the markdown file written, which must be the output path given in the task.

done_is.description: The completion criteria as written into the body, so the author can check them without opening the file.

has_headings.description: True if the body contains any markdown heading. Must be false; an issue body is prose, bullets, then the Done is block.

unused.description: Brief facts deliberately left out, with the reason. Empty array if everything was used.

gaps.description: Specific details the brief lacked, including anything you had to read the repository to resolve. Empty array if none.
